claim: The one-click web demo shows the bundled three-event report with 17 paths, 558.1 KiB for 7 days, and 2.3 MiB for 30 days without saving data.
sandbox: fresh browser context; click from /; assert route, banner, three events, exact report metrics, and empty storage

claim: The website makes no third-party requests or storage writes, and the receiver binds only to loopback.
sandbox: fresh browser context records requests, cookies, and storage; Rust regression asserts the bound address is loopback

claim: The receiver aggregates accepted events and discards their bodies and values unless --save-sample is set.
where: landing facts, privacy page, README, CLI help
sandbox: Rust regressions send a unique value, assert it is absent from the report, and assert bodies_saved is false

claim: The report shows event rate, average size, field paths and types, likely secrets, and retention estimates.
sandbox: bundled NDJSON fixture; assert exact count, event rate, size, every path and type, findings, and both retention values

claim: The separate forwarding command validates an HTTP(S) URL and safely renders it in a configuration.
where: landing recording, demo configuration section, README
sandbox: bundled demo plus Rust regression; assert the command and generated output, reject non-HTTP destinations, and encode unsafe URL characters

claim: The documented public source checkout builds and runs with Cargo.
sandbox: fresh temporary clone of the public GitHub repository; run cargo run --locked -- --help and assert the CLI commands

claim: Operators can add sensitive-field patterns and suppress reviewed exact paths or prefixes.
sandbox: fixture with a custom sensitive key and benign token-shaped fields; assert custom detection plus exact-path and prefix suppression

claim: The receiver accepts 20 requests per rolling second by default and returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After when limited.
sandbox: local receiver at the default limit; assert 20 accepted requests, request 21 gets 429, Retry-After: 1, and a 20-event report

claim: Malformed or incomplete requests return HTTP 400 without ending the sample window or losing accepted events.
sandbox: local receiver receives a valid event, malformed NDJSON, and a short declared body; assert 202 then 400 responses and a one-event report

claim: The receiver writes accepted bodies only when --save-sample is set.
where: landing limits, privacy page, README, CLI help
sandbox: local receiver gets malformed and valid bodies with --save-sample; assert only the accepted body is written and bodies_saved is true

claim: The receiver refuses matching --output and --save-sample paths before opening its listener.
sandbox: use the same existing path for both options; assert startup fails before binding and the existing file stays unchanged

claim: File inspection rejects a sample duration below one second.
sandbox: run inspect with --sample-seconds 0; assert a non-zero exit and Clap range validation

claim: The --json option writes the complete report to standard output.
sandbox: inspect the bundled fixture with --json; parse stdout and assert it equals the report written to the chosen output path

claim: The help command lists every CLI command and global help options.
sandbox: run drain-check --help and assert listen, inspect, demo, forwarding, --help, and --version are present

claim: Ctrl-C finishes the sample early and writes its report.
sandbox: start the compiled listener for 60 seconds, send SIGINT, assert successful exit and a valid report

claim: The installed CLI demo runs from any working directory using its embedded sample and a unique temporary report directory.
sandbox: compiled binary launched from a fresh temporary consumer directory; assert sample metrics and report path outside the repository

claim: The static site build writes deployable files and deployment configuration to dist/site.
sandbox: fresh checkout; run npm run build:site and assert dist/site/index.html plus dist/site/staticwebapp.config.json

claim: Drain Check is free software under the MIT License.
sandbox: read the shipped LICENSE and assert its MIT grant
